summary: Most inventory plugins are enabled by default or via auto. Others are enabled through enable_plugins in the [inventory] section of ansible.cfg, which replaces the default list (host_list, script, auto, yaml, ini, toml). Append collection plugins by FQCN or local ones by name. YAML source names must match the plugin entry.

answer_card.title: Enabling inventory plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Most plugins work by default or via `auto`. Otherwise, set `enable_plugins` in `ansible.cfg`. This **overrides** the default list, so keep the defaults:

```ini
[inventory]
enable_plugins = host_list, script, auto, yaml, ini, toml, namespace.collection_name.inventory_plugin_name
```

A local plugin (for example in `DEFAULT_INVENTORY_PLUGIN_PATH`) can be listed by its short name, such as `my_plugin`.

For YAML-configured plugins, the `plugin:` entry in the source file must match the plugin name.
